limitations: National survey evidence, not city budgets or a household composition model.
Selected source totals and subgroups overlap; no additive UKMR Essentials/Lifestyle mapping is approved.

Essentials/Lifestyle mapping is unapproved and not emitted. No OECD scale, household composition or city multiplier.
